sleep.ui.title: sleep engine settings
sleep.ui.open.tooltip: Settings of the sleep engine: features, shaderpacks, flags
sleep.ui.reset.tooltip: Every engine flag back to the tested defaults (the shaderpack stays)
sleep.ui.restart: Restart the game to apply %s change(s)
sleep.ui.locked: Set by a launch flag (-D%s): change it in the launcher's JVM arguments
sleep.ui.shaders.empty: No packs in the shaderpacks folder yet
sleep.ui.shaders.note: Packs (OptiFine / Iris format, .zip or folder) are run by sleep itself and switch without a restart; the world's chunks are rebuilt.
sleep.ui.group.chunks.desc: Chunks drawn in a few multi-draws, packed vertices, mesh and draw memos, render cache.
sleep.ui.group.entities_render.desc: Entities and block entities drawn in batches, without per-frame garbage.
sleep.ui.group.lighting.desc: Light updates off the render thread, light scouting, shader-side light.
sleep.ui.group.animation.desc: GeckoLib models: parallel bone work, compiled Molang, shared keyframes.
sleep.ui.group.ticks.desc: Sleeping idle mobs, collision and shape memos, neighbour and redstone updates, AI, events.
sleep.ui.group.threads.desc: Main-thread reactor, parallel entities, reused pools.
sleep.ui.group.worldgen.desc: Parallel generation, shared noise, work skipped where it cannot change the result.
sleep.ui.group.saving.desc: Chunk saving and loading off the main thread, chunk caches.
